title: Throw Glove power-up — pick up + throw your bomb over walls
intent: Second new power-up from `gameplay-systems.md §5.3`. Throw Glove extends the Kick concept with longer-range bomb relocation: a bomber holding the glove can PICK UP their own placed bomb (input: hold-action key for 0.3s while standing on the bomb cell) and CARRY it. While carrying, the bomb's fuse pauses; the bomb visually rides on the bomber's back (mounts to torso.back socket). A second input THROW (release-action or press-direction) tosses the bomb 3 cells in the bomber's facing direction in an arc over any obstacles in between. Lands on the destination cell, fuse resumes. Adds a vertical-ish axis without breaking grid authority — pickup and landing are grid-snapped, only the airborne arc is presentational. Highest-impact gameplay-shape change since Kick (S100).
rationale: Source: `gameplay-systems.md §5.3 Throw Glove` (deferred, listed under far-future power-ups with reason 'adds a vertical movement axis'). User direction 2026-05-26: content variety. Throw Glove is more invasive than Pierce/Kick because it changes the BOMB's lifecycle (pause-resume fuse, position transition mid-flight). Marked `could` because it can defer past Pierce + arenas if dev capacity is tight; promoting Pierce + arenas + Conveyor first delivers more content per LOC.
acceptanceHints: Depends on existing power-up infrastructure (Pickup.kind enum, BomberStats flags) — same pattern as Kick/Remote/Shield/Pierce.
examples/kaboom-crew/schemas/scene-extensions.schema.json:
Pickup.kind += 'throw-glove'
BomberStats.canThrow: boolean (default false)
Bomb component gains optional `airborne: boolean` (true during flight; fuse paused)
Bomb component gains optional `carriedBy: EntityId` (set while carried; fuse paused, position snapped to torso.back socket)
New transient: ThrowBombRequest { bomberEntityId } — written by input system on throw action.
New transient: PickupBombRequest { bomberEntityId, bombEntityId } — written by input system on pickup action.
examples/kaboom-crew/src/systems/pickup-collect-system.ts: 'throw-glove' branch sets BomberStats.canThrow = true.
INPUT SCHEME (single-key reuse):
When a bomber stands on their own bomb cell AND BomberStats.canThrow = true: holding Space for 300ms triggers PickupBombRequest. (Tap-Space still places normally; long-press picks up.)
When a bomber is carrying a bomb: tapping Space throws in facing direction (uses S108 bomber-faces-walk-direction).
No new key binding. Existing Space key carries dual meaning when canThrow is set.

examples/kaboom-crew/src/systems/bomb-pickup-system.ts: NEW. Consumes PickupBombRequest. Sets bomb.carriedBy = bomberEntity; removes bomb from GridOccupancy (no longer blocks cells); pauses fuse-decrement in bomb-fuse-system (bomb-fuse-system checks `if (bomb.carriedBy) return;`).

examples/kaboom-crew/src/systems/bomb-throw-system.ts: NEW. Consumes ThrowBombRequest. Computes landing cell = bomber.gridPos + facing.dxdz × 3. Validates: in-bounds + not hard-block + not bomber-occupied. If invalid: try 2 cells, then 1, then place at bomber's cell (graceful fallback).
Spawns Bomb.airborne = true; bomb tweens through an arc over 0.45s — start Y = torso.back height, peak Y = +1.5 cells, land Y = 0. Arc is purely visual; gameplay impact happens at landing.
At landing: Bomb.airborne = false; carriedBy cleared; GridOccupancy.holds-bomb set on landing cell; fuse resumes (use bomb's original fuseRemaining before pickup).
ARC PHYSICS: parabolic tween via existing Tween primitive, not Rapier. Pure presentation. 0.45s duration is short enough to not block placement decisions.
CHAIN INTERACTIONS:
Airborne bomb caught in a blast: chain-trigger normal. The mid-air bomb detonates at its current arc position (visually); blast cells are computed at the landing cell (snap-back).
Bomb thrown into a blast cell that's still active: detonates on landing.
Carried bomb hit by blast: bomber dies, bomb drops at the death cell, fuse resumes (a chain-trap scenario).

VISUAL: while carried, the bomb mesh moves to a new transform parent at torso.back accessory socket. Reuses the existing backpack accessory anchor (per characters-and-visual.md §2.2). Bomb visually mounts as a backpack — flavour win.
AUDIO: new event `bomb-pickup` (low pop) and `bomb-throw` (whoosh). Voice synth (GDP-022-008): the place-bomb voice slot fires once at throw landing (visual sync).
HUD: bottom-left per-bomber line shows `T` flag when canThrow is on. While carrying a bomb, a small icon next to the flag shows '!' or similar.

MULTIPLAYER: server validates PickupBombRequest + ThrowBombRequest (bomber must own the bomb + must be on its cell). Server runs the arc-time-to-landing as a scheduled event (bomb spawns at landing cell after 0.45s server time). Client predicts the arc visually.

BOT AI: bot uses Throw Glove SIMPLY in this story — bots pick up a bomb when their AI's danger map score for their current cell > 0.6 AND they have canThrow, then throw away from the player's predicted position. No clever multi-step planning.
DETERMINISM: pickup + throw timing uses fixedUpdate dt only. Bot-vs-bot regression test passes (potentially slower if bot+throw combos extend rounds, but should resolve within budget).
UNIT TESTS:
Tap-Space on canThrow=true bomber not standing on their bomb → places new bomb (normal behaviour).
Long-press Space on canThrow=true bomber standing on their bomb → PickupBombRequest fires.
Carried bomb fuse doesn't decrement.
Throw with clear path → bomb lands at +3 cells in facing direction.
Throw with hard block at +3 → bomb lands at +2 (graceful fallback).
Throw with hard block at +1 → bomb lands at bomber cell (last-resort fallback).
Carried-bomber dies → bomb drops at death cell, fuse resumes from paused value.
Mid-air bomb caught in blast → chain-triggered, blast computed at land cell.
OUT OF SCOPE:
Multi-step throw (chained throws between players in a 'volley'). Initial cut is single-throw.
Catch mechanic (a bomber catches a thrown bomb mid-flight) — interesting but adds significant timing complexity.
Throwing OPPONENTS' bombs (only your own). Punt — would need rules around bomb ownership transfer.
Throw distance variation by power-up stacking (always 3 cells in v1).
Bot AI: clever throw decisions (predicting player movement). Stretch.
